data_source: Biophysical bi-weekly shelf-break ocean simulation (SST gradient + Chlorophyll-a + GEBCO bathymetry)
note_data_source: INCOIS institutional historical advisories are not available via open REST/API. Dataset is biophysical simulation classifiable as RULE-EMULATION. MOSDAC Oceansat-3 files cover Sep 9-15 2026 only and were NOT used for training.
scientific_basis: INCOIS oceanographic criteria: SST gradient >= 0.60 C/10km and Chl >= 0.55 mg/m3 on shelf 25-850m, evaluated at t+48h
ethical_disclaimer: Predicts favorable oceanographic habitat suitability. NEVER represents guaranteed fish presence.
leakage_safeguards: Target evaluated at t+48h, past lags at t-24h, zero circular formula derivation
